otsu_cross_note: The Otsu cross-check is the naive maskless baseline; its 3 misses are exactly the hard windows where the locator law wins: S010 r5 (dark window + large white burst art — Otsu calls the art the ink; the stroke-precise mask correctly samples the black text strokes), S011 r6 (2.4% white strokes on a dark window), S011 r8 (gray 158 strokes vs Otsu's dark-side pick). Recorded as evidence for the mask-based locator, not as sampler error.

vlm_visual_passes.adjudication: Full-sheet misreads at 130px tile height (S003 r1 tall narrow strip, S009 r1 thin tilted strokes) resolve to the sampler verdicts at 2x. S011 r8 remains perceptually ambiguous (gray 158 reads as white at a glance) but has exact numeric ground truth: the fixture's stroke-precise mask median is BGR 158 == sampler median 158, min 7 / max 255 — gray ink by construction. Sampler holds 10/10 against numeric truth; VLM agrees 9/10 after the 2x re-check, the residual being the gray/white perceptual boundary.

corpus_verdict.note: Committed corpus text ink is black/white/gray only. The 'S001_color_webtoon' archive is a misleading name: its original.jpg is byte-identical to the S003 family source page (md5 ledger above) — a B&W page. The colored arm therefore validates synthetically (C3) + on future Owner pages; on the current corpus the feature is inert by construction (0 keys).
